measurement_notes: Unmeasured job peaks remain null until a completed gate records a representative output size; unknown is not a reservation. Estimates for GCC Debug/Release, ASan/UBSan, and Icarus are exact-SHA observed output-tree sizes and are not filesystem high-water measurements.

Icarus, GCC Debug/Release, and ASan/UBSan output-tree limits use twice the respective measured tree sizes so accumulated smaller files also trigger review. A hosted v5.052 installed prefix measured 257,576,704 bytes across 127 files on commit ae0dbd016ed32abfcaec24351e0679f3b892f3db, with a 231,709,824-byte debug executable. The complete Verilator source-build plus installed-prefix size remains unmeasured; its next exact-SHA scan aggregates both disjoint roots, allows that measured executable under an operation-specific 256 MiB file cap, and will supply the combined baseline before a tree cap or peak estimate is recorded.
The developer profile warns below 50 GiB and blocks below a 40 GiB reserve; these are configurable workstation safeguards, not architecture limits.
The hosted profile retains the existing 2 GiB free-space floor and is independent of developer-workstation thresholds.
